backtest_protocol.execution_model: Signal uses only close-of-day OHLCV available on signal date. Paper entry is next available open with existing entry slippage; exit is the close 10 trading days after the signal with target-side sell slippage and ROUND_TRIP_COST_PCT.
backtest_protocol.source: docs/backtesting.md canonical three-window core replay plus replay-only broad warehouse default-off paper overlay

gate3.note: No new core filter or entry rule was added. The pressure resilience candidate source is additive default-off paper, so core signals generated/survived are unchanged from baseline.

gate_questions.1_alpha_hypothesis: candidate-pool alpha: after broad cross-sectional pressure, liquid sector-known stocks that stay resilient versus SPY/QQQ may be cleaner next-open paper candidates than raw momentum.

2_history_check.exp-20260528-035/036: Sector/industry breadth breakout variants were rejected; this test uses market-wide pressure plus single-day resilience instead of broad sector breadth agreement.
2_history_check.exp-20260605-013: Broad low-beta residual momentum candidate pool was rejected due PnL loss, two window regressions, and drawdown deterioration.
2_history_check.exp-20260605-023: Observed-only breadth alignment did not show a stable monotonic ladder.

gate_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Same three canonical windows. Aggregate EV/PnL must be positive; no EV/PnL regression window; at least 20 paper trades across all 3 windows; survival >=5%; drawdown drift <=0.5pp; concentration pass.

hypothesis: Broad all-windows-full-liquid stocks in the top cross-sectional 5-day SPY-relative return bucket may continue over the next 10 trading days when replayed as a top-1 next-open default-off paper candidate.
interpretation: The 5-day winner-continuation candidate pool did not clear Gate 4; do not promote or retune nearby broad OHLCV momentum on these frozen windows without new forward evidence.
negative_reflection: If rejected, the likely reason is that exp-20260601-008's long-only f5/h10 lead was not incremental over ret20/core momentum; top-1 next-open execution may simply chase already extended winners and decay after costs.
next_evidence_needed: A retry needs a materially new PIT state field, such as real-time breadth/changepoint persistence or cost-adjusted replacement rows; do not simply retune pressure thresholds, hold days, cooldown, or paper notional on this frozen sample.

pre_run_questions.1_alpha_hypothesis: entry/candidate_pool: top cross-sectional 5-day SPY-relative winners in the broad full-liquid stock universe may keep continuing over the next 10 trading days.

2_history_check.exp-20260601-007: Rejected reversal; incidental continuation sign appeared.
2_history_check.exp-20260601-008: Observed long-only f5/h10 excess but did not prove ret20 incrementality.
2_history_check.exp-20260602-015: Stock-only RS acceleration completed but nearby broad OHLCV momentum sources carry high multiple-testing risk.
2_history_check.exp-20260605-013: Low-beta residual momentum rejected; this run tests short formation continuation directly.

pre_run_questions.4_success_failure_criteria: Use docs/backtesting.md three-window before/after aggregate; accept only positive EV and PnL with no window PnL regression, drawdown drift <=0.5pp, survival >=5%, and concentration guard pass.

prediction.confidence_reason: Exp-20260601-008 found long-only f5/h10 excess but not significant ret20-incremental evidence; this run asks whether a stricter top-1, next-open paper execution can still add replacement value.

production_impact.parity_note: This experiment changes no production code. A positive result would require a shared default-off adapter that computes the same warehouse all-windows-full-liquid stock universe, 5-day SPY-relative rank, next-open paper entry, 10-trading-day exit, costs, cooldown, and core-overlap controls in both replay and daily production before any report queue, paper ledger, candidate priority, sizing, watchlist, or order surface could change.
